# VENLAX Sports

> Ranked Tennis and Pickleball leagues across the USA. No club membership. Skill-matched opponents, live standings and playoffs.

## What it is
- Season-based leagues: Flex, Round Robin, Box and Challenge Ladder.
- Singles, doubles and mixed doubles. Your rating updates after every match.
- Home player proposes a date, time and court before the play-by date; Away confirms or suggests another time.

## Pricing (per season, USD)
- Singles: $9.99 per player
- Doubles: $19.99 per team of two (one payment covers both partners)
- Mixed doubles: $19.99 per team of two
- Entry fees are non-refundable once the league starts. Payments are processed by Stripe.
